name: - BRA
fix_description: In _transfer, the sell tax fee is transferred to the pancake pair (or an address that routes to pair) without calling pair.sync() afterwards. This causes pair balance > reserve. Attacker repeatedly calls skim() to extract the excess tokens. Fix: call pair.sync() after transferring tax to pair, or send tax to a non-pair address.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit against an arbitrary-call/token-validation flaw in the zapper: the attacker crafts fake token callbacks and malicious zap parameters to make the contract execute a USDC transferFrom from a victim with existing allowance. It is essentially a single-core-step exploit with minimal DeFi complexity and a compact PoC.
